name: Pool Match Jam 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Pool Match Jam is a lively puzzle-sorting game that puts you in charge of guiding swimmers to their perfect ride down a colorful water slide. Your mission is to strategically clear the grid by matching tubes with an active line of swimmers, creating the ideal path for them to jump onto a lifesaver and make their way down the water slide.
